INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

4. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.

7. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.

8. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.

9. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.

10. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Information and Communication Technology

2. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. A — CPU

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.

5. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

11. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Digital Citizenship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Emerging Trends in ICT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Artificial Intelligence; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Robotics; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
